What changed in this PR Addresses #773 by making port truncation deterministic in the firewall rule processor, so identical rules consistently enforce the same entries when a CIDR exceeds the 24-entry limit. **Changes:** - Sort deduplicated entries by protocol, port, and end port, treating nil fields as zero values. - Add regression tests for input-order independence and stable selection of the first 24 ports. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `pkg/​fwruleprocessor/​fw_rule_processor.go` | Sorts deduplicated L4 entries before trie encoding. | | `pkg/​fwruleprocessor/​fw_rule_processor_test.go` | Tests sorted deduplication and deterministic truncation with 30 TCP ports. |
Review effort: Balanced
